source_refs.note: Topic 1.8.1, printed page 15: the reactions of sodium and magnesium with water and steam.

blocks.text: Sodium is more reactive than magnesium towards water. Sodium reacts vigorously with water to form sodium hydroxide and hydrogen, while magnesium reacts more slowly to form magnesium hydroxide and hydrogen. Magnesium, however, reacts more vigorously with steam to make magnesium oxide and hydrogen gas.
